name: @kealthas-dev/opencode-loop-guard
description: loop-guard.ts opencode plugin: stops a model from calling the same tool with the same arguments over and over - warns after 3 identical calls with identical results and refuses a 6th identical read/grep/glob call. Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type (type-only). Independently installable - not bundled with the other plugins.
